SELECT
( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON u.user_id = ur.user_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.role_id WHERE u.del_flag = '0' AND u.status = '0' AND r.role_key = 'assess_student'
AND u.dept_id = #{deptId}
) AS studentCount,
COUNT(CASE WHEN d.status = '1' THEN 1 END) AS pendingCount,
COUNT(CASE WHEN d.status = '2' THEN 1 END) AS reviewingCount,
COUNT(CASE WHEN d.status IN ('3','4') THEN 1 END) AS passedCount,
COUNT(CASE WHEN d.status = '5' THEN 1 END) AS rejectedCount,
COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN d.status != '0' THEN d.total_score END), 0) AS avgScore FROM assess_declaration d WHERE d.del_flag = '0'
AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_user u WHERE u.user_id = d.user_id AND u.dept_id = #{deptId})
